other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (unorganised sector)
Applicant must have worked at least 90 days in a year in building and construction work
Applicant's monthly income must be ₹15,000 or below
Applicant must not be a member of any other welfare fund established under any law
Applicant must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must be the spouse of a deceased registered construction worker under the Board
The deceased worker must have completed at least one year of membership with the Board
benefits_summary: A family pension of ₹1,000 per month is provided to the surviving spouse until remarriage or until the spouse becomes eligible for their own pension.
